faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to common questions about Klaim Health.

items.question: What is Klaim?
items.answer: Klaim is a specialized platform that purchases approved insurance claims from healthcare providers through a Shariah-compliant Murabaha program, enabling faster access to receivables and improved cash flow without loans or additional financing obligations.

items.question: How does Klaim work?
items.answer: Once approved, you submit approved insurance claims to Klaim. We finance them at the agreed value and transfer the funds directly to your account within 48 hours.

items.question: Is Klaim a bank or lender?
items.answer: No. Klaim does not provide loans or credit. We buy approved receivables outright, giving you immediate cash flow without adding debt to your balance sheet.

items.question: What types of receivables does Klaim purchase?
items.answer: Klaim purchases approved insurance claims from healthcare providers only.

items.question: How fast do I get paid?
items.answer: Typically within 48 hours of submitting approved insurance claims to Klaim.

items.question: Do I need collateral or a personal guarantee?
items.answer: No. Our model is based on purchasing your approved receivables. There is no requirement for collateral or personal guarantees.

items.question: Does using Klaim affect my existing billing or collection process?
items.answer: No. You continue operating as usual. Klaim simply purchases your approved receivables so you can access your funds sooner, without disrupting your operational workflows.

items.question: Are there any contracts or lock-in commitments?
items.answer: No. Klaim offers flexible, on-demand solutions with no long-term commitments. You choose when and which receivables to sell.

items.question: Is Klaim available across the UAE and KSA?
items.answer: Klaim currently supports healthcare providers in Saudi Arabia and continues expanding its regional presence.

items.question: How is Klaim different from traditional financing or factoring?
items.answer: Unlike traditional loans or factoring, Klaim purchases approved insurance claims through a Murabaha structure, helping maintain financial strength and improve cash flow predictability.
